subject: Summer Showcase — Sponsor credit and pipeline Q&A
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Kyle Pritchard <kyle@luminahealth.io>
Date: 2025-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Summer Showcase — Sponsor credit and pipeline Q&A

Team / Kyle —

Thanks for joining the debrief notes earlier. Attached is the initial pipeline export from HubSpot and the draft sponsor credit summary for the SF Summer Showcase (SF Convention Center, 2025-08-22). Quick highlights: 

- Total leads collected (event forms + QR scans): 142
- Leads attributed to sponsor interactions (auto-match + manual tag): 23
- Revenue-influencing opportunities (>=50% close prob): 6, total ARR $27,600
- Sponsor credit requested (Lumina Health): 23 leads (100% of their interactions)

Action items I need confirmed this week:
1) Kyle — can you confirm which of the 23 leads you believe should be fully credited to Lumina (you noted on-site registrations vs follow-ups)? If you can attach your vendor CSV or HubSpot IDs that helps speed reconciliation.
2) Ben / Marissa — can you run the lead-matching export and flag any leads that match pre-existing accounts (we frequently de-dupe to existing contacts or partner-sourced leads)?
3) Rachel — please pull the form/QR logs (UTM parameters + scan timestamps) and highlight anything within the sponsor footprint window (12:30–16:30 on 2025-08-22).

We want to resolve credit before we close the event invoice cycle (COGS run 9/05). If we can agree on a reconciliation, Naomi will sign off the sponsor credit note.

Attachments: SF_Summer_Showcase_pipeline.xlsx (HubSpot export, with lead ids), summary slide.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

From: Kyle Pritchard <kyle@luminahealth.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summer Showcase — Sponsor credit and pipeline Q&A

Naomi —

Thanks for the summary. We reviewed on our side and believe Lumina should receive full credit for the 23 leads we collected. On-site staff scanned badges and collected contact details; several of those attendees booked a demo within 48 hours (HubSpot IDs included below). Happy to share our CSV of onsite scans — attaching a lightweight extract.

Quick callouts: 
- HubSpot IDs: 45231, 45278, 45302, 45311 (these converted to MQL and have Lumina UTM values in our copy of the export)
- Two of the leads were re-assigned to an AE after initial follow; we believe reassignment was manual and post-event, not originating from another sponsor.

We need the sponsor credit reflected before the final invoice or we will escalate the overage to our procurement lead. Please advise by EOD Friday.

Best,
Kyle Pritchard
Partnerships Lead | Lumina Health
kyle@luminahealth.io | (202) 555-0146

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kyle Pritchard <kyle@luminahealth.io>
Date: 2025-08-30T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summer Showcase — Sponsor credit and pipeline Q&A

Kyle / Naomi / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick note, Kyle. I pulled the matching export and ran a de-dupe against our account base. Two immediate items to call out: 

1) Of the 23 leads that Lumina flagged, 5 match pre-existing accounts in HubSpot with created_dates prior to the event (these appear to be inbound leads we had in the system already; they resurfaced when the lead enrichment ran). In our sponsorship policy those do not convert to sponsor credit because they were not sourced at the event. I've attached the lead-matching log for details.
2) There are 4 leads that have conflicting UTM attribution — the form submits show partner=lumina but the initial touch in HubSpot is a paid campaign we ran 2 weeks prior. For those, our playbook splits credit 50/50 unless a sponsor can prove ownership (signed LOE or on-site registration form).

Proposed next step: 30-minute reconciliation on Friday (2025-09-05) to walk the 14 disputed leads and land on final owners. If Lumina can provide a CSV with their onsite scan timestamps mapped to HubSpot IDs, that will let us reconcile faster.

Attaching: lead-matching-log.csv (columns: hubspot_id, match_reason, prior_account_id).

Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (646) 555-0109

From: Kyle Pritchard <kyle@luminahealth.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-30T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summer Showcase — Sponsor credit and pipeline Q&A

Ben —

Appreciate the export. We disagree with the 'prior account' designation on the five leads. Two of them were initial intake badges collected by Lumina staff on-site and only later enriched into HubSpot as part of our handover. I attached our event-scans extract (lumina_evidence_08030.csv) which includes timestamps, staff initials, and badge IDs. Those timestamps fall inside the sponsor footprint you referenced.

We cannot accept a delayed partial credit. The sponsor exposure and hand-collection at our booth drove the conversations that converted. If Redwood insists on de-dup rules that strip sponsor credit, we will request a one-time credit adjustment for the show and revisit our renewal.

We are available to join the Friday call but ask that this be prioritized ahead of your invoice run.

Thanks,
Kyle

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-02T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summer Showcase — Sponsor credit and pipeline Q&A

Internal summary (final reconciliation):

Thanks all for joining the Friday review and for the additional evidence from Lumina. After line-by-line reconciliation we agreed to the following allocation: 

- Lumina credited leads: 18 (18/23) — these were either verified onsite scans with matching HubSpot ids or had direct demo bookings within 48 hours with Lumina staff involvement.
- Redwood retains: 5 leads — these matched pre-existing accounts or had a stronger prior touch that meets our sourcing policy.
- Sponsor credit note: Lumina will receive a $2,400 credit applied to their next invoice (agreed by finance based on per-lead credit of $400 for verified leads beyond the baseline).

Operational changes / next steps:
1) Update HubSpot deal records for the 18 credited leads and add sponsor_tag:lumina (Ben) — target complete by EOD 2025-09-03.
2) Change event playbook: require sponsor badge-capture sheet + HubSpot id mapping on site to avoid future disputes (Marissa / Naomi to draft).
3) Technical: Rachel to add Sponsor QR UTM parameter to Lumina's QR codes and add timestamped scans to our export script.
4) Finance: issue credit memo referencing deal D-8742-LH (Rachel to confirm).

Attachments: final_reconciliation_20250831.pdf (summary with line items).

I'll close the loop with Kyle and Lumina after the HubSpot tags are updated. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
